# Documentation automation

## Generator

The repository-level generator lives in `scripts/generate_quarto_docs.py`.

It:

- scans the repository root
- ignores common cache/build/vendor folders and binary files
- mirrors documentable files into `docs/reference/`
- generates directory `index.qmd` pages
- removes stale generated pages when source files disappear

## Workflow

The GitHub Actions workflow in `.github/workflows/quarto-docs.yml` runs on pushes and manual dispatch.

When source files change, it:

1. checks out the repository
2. runs the Python generator
3. commits and pushes generated documentation updates if needed

## Local usage

```bash
python scripts/generate_quarto_docs.py --clean
```

If Quarto is installed locally, you can render the site from the `docs/` directory:

```bash
quarto render docs
```
